flags.why: Hành hình means execution, not carrying out punishments generally ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-h%C3%A0nh%20h%C3%ACnh)).
flags.fix: to execute (a condemned person); to carry out a death sentence

flags.why: The festival meaning of tết is not restricted to foreign festivals or use in quotation marks ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/tet-ewuZYf7i8N7aU.html)).
flags.fix: Merge this sense with Tết sense 2 and remove the rare tag and the restrictions about foreign festivals and quotation marks.
